request: Exactly two lifecycle owners: conversation/session and message. Keep turn and interruption decisions out of dispatcher. Start idle timeout and mark assistant message complete after accepted playback completion.
acceptance_criteria: Session lifecycle owns connection transitions and idle/max-session countdown configuration, cancellation, and expiry acceptance.
Message lifecycle owns context rotation, user/assistant transitions, interruption decision state, held packets, decision timer, playback acceptance, and message completion emission decisions.
Dispatcher routes packets and performs I/O; it does not independently own lifecycle state or reconstruct decisions using getters and setters.
Move ownership with existing behavior preserved before enabling callback-driven audio completion.
Accepted audio completion emits the existing assistant_turn=complete metric packet and idle-start packet; TTS end alone does neither.
New activity cancels idle timing. Delayed start/expiry requests cannot override newer activity.
Duplicate, stale, missing, and failed completion paths cannot manufacture successful message completion.
Text-only completion does not require a playback callback. No third lifecycle is introduced.
out_of_scope: Provider implementations and new configuration options
New controllers, lifecycle owners, or generic helper packages

ownership.coordinator: Message interruption/turn implementation, requestor and dispatch integration, RFC, and validation.
ownership.session_worker: Session lifecycle/countdown implementation and tests, then disjoint VAD lifecycle and dispatch implementation.
ownership.test_worker: Adapter fixture migration and message interruption regression tests.
ownership.reviewer: Independent read-only review of the ownership delta, concurrency, and completion contracts.

implementation_boundary.completed: Ownership movement, preserving existing generation/TTS completion timing. Message lifecycle admits turns/input/prompts and owns interruption state/control ordering. Session lifecycle owns idle/max-session countdowns and acceptance.
implementation_boundary.pending: Callback-authoritative audio completion metrics and idle start. Resolve whole-message versus same-ID segment receipts before enabling this behavior.
implementation_boundary.compatibility: No proto or streamer contract changes in this ownership refactor. Existing callback observation and metric names are retained.

sequence: Confirm two-owner boundary and map existing state, timer, and effect ordering.
Move interruption/turn decisions into message lifecycle and countdown decisions into session lifecycle without changing observable behavior.
Implement callback completion and idle handoff through lifecycle-owned decisions and existing packets.
Verify focused behavior and races, then independently review before merge.
risks: Provider/streamer calls must remain outside lifecycle locks; async I/O outcomes must be validated before committing state.
Timer cancellation does not invalidate callbacks already running; preserve active-message and decision-sequence fences.
Flush must precede context rotation; held packets must replay once in order after downstream turn changes.

Several TTS segments may share a message ID. Their delayed completion receipts are indistinguishable with the current protocol. Resolve response-wide completion before enabling whole-message completion for that path.
No-callback gRPC clients cannot be assumed to have completed playback; do not invent success from Send returning.
verification_note: Four-package race tests, full assistant-api compile, and exact-file agent-finalize passed. Independent review found no critical or major findings. See amendment-01-lifecycle-ownership-review.json. Callback-authority behavior remains pending.
rollback: Keep the ownership refactor and callback behavior change as separate reviewable deltas. Restore the prior callback-observation behavior without reverting existing streamer/protobuf work if callback authority is not ready.
review: User approved the ownership refactor. Independent read-only implementation review found no critical or major issues. Same-ID receipt ambiguity remains a preexisting limit for the future callback-authority change. No exact-digest gate is claimed for this Standard internal refactor.
